zh.title: 英國法院下令全球凍結VietJet Aviation資產
zh.summary: 英國法院下令全球凍結VietJet Aviation資產，FWA追討判決款項
body: 英國商業法院已對VietJet Aviation下達全球資產凍結令。命令於2026年10月15日作出；FW Aviation Holdings1 Limited（FWA）尋求追回超過$250 million的未償法院判決款項。
法院認為，在FWA繼續追討款項期間，VietJet可能將資產移出債權人可追索範圍，存在實際風險。
這起爭議源於四架空中巴士A321的租賃協議，飛機於2018年及2019年交付給VietJet。報導並指出，這項凍結令不代表VietJet的飛機訂單已取消。

en.title: UK court orders worldwide freeze of VietJet Aviation assets as FWA pursues judgments
en.summary: UK court freezes VietJet Aviation assets; FWA seeks recovery of outstanding judgments
body: The UK Commercial Court has granted a worldwide asset-freezing order against VietJet Aviation. The order was granted on 15 October 2026, as FW Aviation Holdings1 Limited (FWA) seeks to recover more than $250 million in outstanding court judgments.
The court found a real risk that VietJet could move assets beyond creditors’ reach while FWA continues its recovery efforts.
The dispute began over lease agreements for four Airbus A321 aircraft delivered to VietJet in 2018 and 2019. The order does not mean VietJet’s aircraft orders have been cancelled.
